_doc: Official-book gate (Luis approved 2026-10-12: back to what worked Aug31-Sep11). Enforced in code by desk/official_rules.py. Market-based clearing; sim is info only.
closing_line: required on every official bet: close_price_american/close_line captured from the last pre-kick board, clv_pp computed at grade

grades.A: passes every rule and fits the daily cap (2-5/day, <=5u) - the bettable card
grades.B: solid but misses exactly one rule (incl. cap overflow) - tracked, not bet
grades.C: lean / near coin-flip / hard-blocked (sim, teaser, parlay, ATD, long-shot) - board only, tracked

market_only._doc: edge source = best price vs consensus no-vig; model% = consensus no-vig. Model-% floors calibrated for a real model are dropped; edge floors kept.
